**MyChats** is a real-time chat platform with an AI layer. Here's the breakdown:

## Core Concept
A private chat app where an **admin controls multiple device accounts**, and those accounts participate in a **shared live chat** in real time. It also supports **AI tools** (like translators) that run in isolated, per-device contexts.

## Architecture
A two-tier TypeScript monorepo:

```
mychats/
├── backend/   # Node.js + Express + TS + Mongoose + SSE  (port 5223)
│   ├── auth/   # Multi-account & device credentials, JWT auth
│   ├── chat/   # Live chat, SSE broadcasts, AI proxy
│   └── tools/  # AI custom tools studio & system prompts
└── frontend/  # Next.js 16 + MUI + SSE  (port 3000)
    ├── app/    # Routes: / (chat), /admin, /login, /tools
    └── components/ # ChatBox, ChatToolbar, MessageList, Sidebar
```

## Key Features
| Feature | Behavior |
|---------|----------|
| **Live Chat** | Shared globally across all devices in real time via SSE |
| **Chat Tools** (e.g. translator) | Device-isolated conversations |
| **Device Identity** | Each device gets a persistent `deviceId` sent via `x-device-id` header |
| **Admin Panel** | Only the authenticated admin can manage device accounts |
| **AI Proxy** | Forwards to a local llama.cpp endpoint (`https://myai.lmstream.xyz/v1`) |

## Notable Design Points
- **Public registration is disabled** — it's admin-only.
- **Non-ASCII HTTP headers** (like an emoji-laden `x-device-id`) must be `encodeURIComponent`-encoded on the client, else browsers throw the ISO-8859-1 error.
- **Next.js SSR quirk** — date formatting needs `suppressHydrationWarning` to avoid timestamp mismatches.

---
